description.narrative: The project is implemented in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, Kosovo and Serbia. The main outcome areas it contributes to are democracy anad human rights, equality and worker's rights, gender equality. The main right holders are workers in the LGBTI community. Through alliance-building, advocacy and capacity-building, the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between ERA - LGBTI Equal Rights Association for Western Balkans and Turkey, LGBTI Social Democrats (HBT-S) and The Palme Center. ERA is an umbrella organisation for LGBTI organisations in the region. HBT-S are part of the Swedish Social Democrats and work for improved LGBTI rights.Project ObjectiveThe project objective is that the LGBTI movement in the Western Balkans allies with the labour movement in creating public policies that improve the social position of LGBTI persons.Actor groups--Decision makers-- National parliaments Ministries Local governments Social and economic councils --Actors in Cooperation-- LGBTI+ organisations Equality/gender equality bodies Political parties --Rights holders-- LGBTI community (with an emphasis on LGBTI youth and LBQ women) Under-represented groups who are LGBTI (Roma, LGBTI persons with disability, ethnic minorities) LGBTI workers Statistics sections - unknowns" refers to non-binary, gender non-conforming people."
